descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Perimeter, Area, Capacity, Mass, and Time (E2.1-E2.9)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 3 unit on measurement framed around Roo the Ruler Rabbit and Cal the Calendar Cat at Farmer Phil's farm. Children measure perimeter, area in cm² and m², capacity, mass, and time.
long_description: Roo the Ruler Rabbit and Cal the Calendar Cat help Farmer Phil! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 3 unit covers ALL 9 E2 expectations (E2.1-E2.9). Day 1 measures PERIMETER with mm/cm/m/km benchmarks. Day 2 compares AREAS by matching, covering, decomposing. Day 3 introduces SQUARE CM and M for area. Day 4 measures CAPACITY and MASS with non-standard units. Day 5 closes with TIME (analog + digital) and a Big Farm Capstone. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-3 trap: around-vs-inside, careless-cover, unit-size mismatch, unit-vs-attribute, hour/minute mix), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 5-row summative rubric, and Junior Measurer G3 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day measurement unit (E2.1-E2.9).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on measurement investigation with character-driven farm frame, structured pair work, and progressive complexity from G2 measurement unit.
